sample_unit: patients with type 2 diabetes (Nanjing development cohort; 25,506 in Shanghai external cohort)

links.outcome: External discrimination of LASSO-Cox risk models in independent Shanghai cohort
links.effect: External C-indices were 0.778 for incident complications and 0.812 for mortality in the independent Shanghai cohort.
links.quote: External C-indices were 0.778 for incident complications and 0.812 for mortality.

unlisted_practices: MDP-based personalized follow-up timing and modality planning with cost-effectiveness (ICER) evaluation

screen.reason: The study develops and externally validates risk prediction models and a Markov decision process simulation for personalized diabetes follow-up planning, but it does not evaluate an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
